name: ru.yoomoney.sdk.auth.socialAccounts.vkId.VkIdActivity
description: When a user chooses VK ID in the YooMoney Authorization SDK, this Activity starts VK's fast sign-in flow and returns its result to the authorization screen. The YooKassa Android payment SDK also includes this authorization screen.
disableEffect: Users cannot finish signing in or linking an account through VK ID from this SDK.
